title: Mixed Event — The Tomorrow We Hope For — Episode4 Everyone's First Shrine Visit

meta.Event Outline: When Haruka stops by the shrine along her usual running route, she sees the shrine maiden who was there for her in her time of need collapse. In order to repay her for her kindness, Haruka decides to help out at the shrine in her stead.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! Me! Pick me!!
I think we should all visit a shrine together!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Where's this coming from?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I was talking to Honami the other day, and she told me about how she and her friends all visited a shrine together! I thought it'd be great if we went too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A shrine...!
That's where everything goes JINGLE-JINGLE-CLANG-CLANG, right♪ Sounds like fun☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Jingle-jingle...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe she's referring to either the bell you ring when making a wish or the sound of drawing a fortune from an omikuji tube.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, none of you had a chance to go last year because you spent all your time discussing show ideas here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
In that case, why not go this year?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna go too♪
Drawing fortunes sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me too!
What about you, Luka? I mean, you were the one who suggested this...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I want to have a nice, relaxing New Year's where I do absolutely nothing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh no you don't! You're coming with us! I'm not about to let you hibernate through the holidays!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: H-Hey, wake up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I should be free to go.
How about the rest of you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, Saki said that she'll be staying over at Ichika's for New Year's, so we probably won't be visiting as a family until the evening...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So I should be free to go around noon!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!!
Nene, what about you?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How about it, Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can go, but shrines get so crowded on New Year's Day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...
Okay, fine, I'll go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!! Thank you so much!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yaaay!!
We get to do a shrine show!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see... Since we're all going, it'll be good to come up with some special effects to mark the occasion...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Special effects for a shrine visit...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey! No weird gadgets or contraptions, alright?!
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay...
Here are those chips that are supposed to be New-Year's-cuisine flavored.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kanade!
Can you put them in that plate over there?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can I start pouring the juice?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it. Oh, we should probably move everything closer towards the middle so nothing spills or falls over.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling this is going to be a wonderful party.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What are you all doing...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, there you are. We were just getting ready to have a party.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A party?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, a New Year's Eve Countdown Party! The one we did last year was super fun, so we decided to do one again this year♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Lemme guess. You couldn't get tickets to the anime song countdown show again and didn't have anything else to do?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you talking about?!
Don't be a party pooper, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But since we're all here, why don't we do some other New Year's stuff this year instead of just a countdown?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Other New Year's stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Like eating mochi or visiting a shrine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, Airi just sent me this... <We're volunteering as shrine maidens at a local shrine.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
Did she say, “We”...?! Do you know what this means?! Real-life idols dressed up as shrine maidens!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu, why does Mizuki sound so excited...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because Mizuki likes idols and shrine maidens?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: MMJ dressed up as shrine maidens...! We've gotta see this!! How about it, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really? All of us...?
I mean, I was sort of thinking about seeing how Airi's doing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Kanade, Mafuyu, what do you two think?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get that leading with seeing idols dressed as shrine maidens wasn't great, but I do kinda want to visit a shrine together with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's cold, so I'd rather not go outside...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, it's supposed to be warmer than usual that day, so it shouldn't be that bad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. It's been pretty warm all winter, so we'll get an early taste of spring during the holidays. Which is why I'm thinking about going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
In that case, I might go...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Awesome!!
How about you, Mafuyu? Do you think you can make it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to be with my family during the day...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I always have some free time at night, so I'll ask to see if they'll let me go...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...!!
Thanks, Mafuyu!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I was wondering why they were all gathered like this...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But I guess there's nothing to be concerned about...)
